boat.construction_details: GRP, Mahogany trim Douglas Fir spars

for_sales.sales_text:
19 ft Memory 2 berth weekender for sale. 1/3 side decked and toe rails. Built in 1979 of glass fibre hull and deck/cockpit fitted out with mahogany trim.

Masts and spars in Douglas fir including 7ft bowsprit all in good condition. Standing rigging galvanised wire with soft eyes hand spliced and served traditionally. Running rigging all Marlowe hardy hemp with Jacobsen’s wooden shell and nylon sleeves. Full set of sails, main (with 2 slab reefing points) staysail, jib, storm jib, topsail and genoa – all in good condition. Lifting centreplate. 1 YANMAR 6.5 hp inboard diesel in good condition.

ST instrument – depth, cockpit and mainsail cover, 1 anchor.

An outstanding example of this popular sailing yacht. She is clean and structurally sound, has been maintained and serviced regularly for over 25 years. 2024 Survey available on request.

Currently moored at Bosham in Chichester Harbour – moving round to Dell Quay Marine in late September.
